lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, with higher spatial density observed in the region immediately posterior to the branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of high-luminance blobs, forming a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and defined shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, white, linear feature indicative of an external attachment or parasite is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the primary visible pectoral fin.
